_comment: S13 clinical glossary — the canonical rendering of a handful of core symptom words in each pilot language. The language QA harness (app.lang_qa) uses it two ways: it proves each entry is complete and in the right script, and wherever one of these words appears in the tree bank as a whole answer/label (e.g. an option that is exactly 'Fever'), it proves the tree used THIS translation and not a synonym. That is what keeps 'fever' from being ताप on one screen and बुखार-borrowed on another. en/hi were fixed by S4's authored text; mr/te are S13, model-drafted, pending native clinical review at S21.
